name: DualPools
fix_description: In redeemFresh, after computing redeemTokens via divScalarByExpTruncate, add a check: require(redeemTokens > 0). Without this, precision truncation allows redeeming underlying tokens while burning zero vTokens when the redeem amount is small relative to the exchange rate.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step exploit involving nested flash loans, Pancake swap/flash callback flows, Venus market entry and collateralized borrowing, plus interaction with a protocol-specific Dualpools market. While the bug is exploitable in a single transaction, writing it requires understanding several DeFi primitives and protocol-specific lending logic, making it more than a straightforward access-control or simple reentrancy case.
